pathRule: Every `file` path an index records is relative to THAT index's own directory, so `chunks/0x00b59c00.lua` in lua/index.json is <binary>/lua/chunks/0x00b59c00.lua on disk.
rule: Every resource leaf is read. Its bytes are committed when the payload measures as text, when it decodes to a structure (RT_VERSION, RT_STRING), or when it is at most 65536 bytes; larger binary payloads are recorded with size and sha256 and their bytes discarded, which is this repo's art-and-sound rule applied by measurement. Nothing is skipped because of its type.
